reuse.why: Adds a sibling guard next to the existing link.ensureAccountIsNotLinked and calls it the same way; it does not route through the partially shared linkBankSyncAccount, but that helper only serves two of the six providers.

duplication.why: The rule itself is defined once; only a one-line guard call is repeated at six provider entry points, mirroring the existing ensureAccountIsNotLinked pattern.

placement.why: The guard lives in link.ts beside the other link precondition, with its unit tests in link.test.ts.

scope.why: Only the guard, its six call sites and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear, named, tested precondition; a new provider must remember to call two guards, a risk the tree already had.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts ensureAccountIsOpen, called by all six link* functions in accounts/app.ts
